issue: Safety-critical oversimplification that contradicts E-F05/E-F07. Lines 13.9-13.10 describe a work procedure ('switch off with a load-breaking device, then isolate visibly') that is not in the facts and is not the five safety rules (E-F05 rule one is Freischalten, E-F07 10.4 says 'Freischalten ist mehr'). It reads as safety instruction and omits securing against re-switching, verifying dead, earthing, covering. No legal/safety instructions allowed.
suggested_fix: DE: Darum ist Freischalten nur der erste Schritt der fünf Sicherheitsregeln. | AR: لذلك فإن فصل الجهد ليس سوى الخطوة الأولى من قواعد السلامة الخمس. | EN: That is why isolating is only the first step of the five safety rules.

issue: See 13.9: 'Danach trennt man sichtbar und sicher' completes an unsupported, incomplete work sequence.

issue: Wrong/misleading: 'Es gibt keine Grenze zwischen Ihrem Projekt und dem Netz' contradicts the whole logic of Netzanschluss (connection point, Hausanschlusssicherung, NAV §13 responsibility boundary, E-A02). Not in facts.

issue: DE says 'Jedes Jahr oder alle paar Jahre' (vague; the NEP cycle is not annual: biennial under EnWG §12b, research says only 'Laufender Zyklus prüfen'), while AR and EN say only 'from time to time' - DE/AR/EN inconsistent and cycle not in facts.
suggested_fix: DE: Der Plan wird regelmäßig neu erstellt. | AR: ويُعاد إعداد الخطة بانتظام. | EN: The plan is prepared anew at regular intervals.
